E1 shows that chemical short-range order causes higher strain peaks and wider strain wavelengths, linking SRO to heterogeneous strain. premises: Heterogeneous lattice strain fields arise from severe atomic size mismatch in HEAs
Local chemical ordering (SRO) modulates these heterogeneous strain fields
Heterogeneous strain fields create natural dislocation pinning sites
This pinning increases dislocation entanglement and impedes plastic deformation
SRO-enhanced strain heterogeneity increases hardness and yield strength relative to random solid solutions
